places.ai_summary: Main downtown strip filled with mid-century modern boutiques, restaurants, and art galleries. Lined with palm trees and desert mountains in the backdrop.
places.place_tip: Visit during Thursday VillageFest street fair.

places.name: VillageFest Palm Springs
places.ai_summary: Weekly open-air market along Palm Canyon Drive with local crafts, food stalls, and live entertainment. A lively evening experience showcasing local culture.
places.place_tip: Arrive early for best parking and local treats.

places.name: Sunnylands Center & Gardens
places.ai_summary: Historic desert estate known as the ‘Camp David of the West,’ hosting U.S. presidents and world leaders. Gardens feature native plants and contemporary architecture.
places.place_tip: Book tours in advance—they sell out quickly.
places.cost: Free garden entry; paid house tour

places.name: Joshua Tree National Park (West Entrance)
places.ai_summary: Just 45 minutes from Palm Springs, this national park offers surreal desert landscapes, unique rock formations, and star-filled night skies. Ideal for hikers and stargazers.
places.place_tip: Enter early to avoid long lines at the gate.

places.name: Disneyland Park
places.ai_summary: Opened in 1955, Disneyland is Walt Disney’s original theme park, featuring classic rides, live shows, and themed lands from Fantasyland to Tomorrowland. A must-visit for families and Disney fans worldwide.
places.place_tip: Arrive early; download the Disneyland app for line updates.

places.name: Disney California Adventure Park
places.ai_summary: The sister park to Disneyland, offering Pixar-themed rides, Avengers Campus, and spectacular nighttime shows like World of Color. Perfect for thrill seekers and Disney fans.
places.place_tip: Book Genie+ passes for Radiator Springs Racers early.

places.name: Downtown Disney District
places.ai_summary: Pedestrian promenade connecting Disneyland parks with dining, live music, and shops. Great for relaxing after a park visit with no admission ticket required.
places.place_tip: Catch fireworks view from the west end courtyard.

places.name: Anaheim Packing House
places.ai_summary: Historic citrus packing warehouse turned trendy food hall featuring 30+ eateries, craft bars, and live music. A cultural landmark for food lovers.
places.place_tip: Visit during live jazz nights for the full experience.

places.name: Honda Center
places.ai_summary: Indoor arena hosting NHL’s Anaheim Ducks games, major concerts, and live shows. One of Southern California’s premier entertainment venues.
places.place_tip: Arrive early for parking and pre-show dining.

places.name: Yorba Regional Park
places.ai_summary: Beautiful linear park along the Santa Ana River Trail featuring lakes, picnic areas, and bike rentals. Great for families and joggers.
places.place_tip: Bring snacks; ideal picnic spot with shade and lake views.

places.name: Flightdeck Flight Simulation Center
places.ai_summary: Interactive aviation experience where visitors pilot authentic fighter jet and Boeing simulators. Great for thrill seekers and aviation fans.
places.place_tip: Book group sessions for multiplayer dogfights.

places.place_tip: Check calendar for free outdoor concerts.

places.ai_summary: Smaller family amusement park offering rides for kids, petting zoo, and live shows. Perfect for younger children near central Anaheim.
places.place_tip: Buy online tickets to avoid weekend queues.
